$comment: Weights for the output-equivalent token (OET) metric. Each is a RATIO between published
rates, never an absolute price: ratios move far more slowly than the prices they come from,
so a stale table degrades gracefully instead of lying.
bucket.cacheWrite  0.25  5-minute-TTL cache-write rate against the output rate
bucket.cacheRead   0.02  cache-read rate against the output rate
model.*  each model family's output rate against the opus output rate.
A model the table does not name falls back to model.default = 1.00 — the conservative
direction, because under-weighting an unrecognised agent hides spend.
